versions.content: Service Name IdsM_GetReportingMode Syntax Std_ReturnType IdsM_GetReportingMode ( IdsM_SecurityEventIdType securityEventId, IdsM_SensorInstanceIdType sensorInstanceId, IdsM_Filters_ReportingModeType * reportingMode ) Service ID [hex] 0x14 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant securityEventId External ID of the Security Event from whom the reporting mode shall be returned sensorInstanceId ID of the sensor instance of the security event Parameters (in) reportingMode The reporting mode for the requested Security Event Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK : Request successful E_NOT_OK : Request failed IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID : Request failed since invalid input argument IDSM_E_BUSY : Request failed since service is busy Description This API is the application interface to get the current reporting mode of security event. Available via IdsM.h
